headline: Harbor Master, finance, and public facilities reports with discussion of off-season strategic priorities.
summary: The board will review the Harbor Master's season update and facility projects, hear a finance report on budget and fees, and discuss public facilities site visits and strategic priorities for the off season.
items: Harbor Master report: Season 2026 update on bookings, staffing, revenue and expenses
St Peters timeline and use of boardwalk
Fees discussed for change in next fiscal year
Public Facilities report: site visits update (I4C2, St Peter's Public Doc/Landing, 112 Commercial Street)
Discussion of strategic direction and off season priorities: financial, staffing, board makeup, and where to focus limited resources
Discussion items not reasonably anticipated by the Chairperson, per M.G.L, CH. 30A, Sec. 18-25

CITY CLERK GLOUCESTER. MA
2026 OCT -2 PM 12:06

# Notice of Public Meeting
## City of Gloucester
## Waterways Board
## October 6, 2026, 6:00 PM
## Harbor Master Conference Room –
## Gloucester, MA 01930

The public is welcome to attend in person.

Zoom link to access the meeting remotely is also available:

Please note that the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if technological problems interrupt the remote connection

## Agenda

1. Oral Communications
2. Approval of Minutes – July 2026
3. Harbor Master report

   a. Season 2026 update – bookings, staffing revenue and expenses
   b. Schooner festival recap
   c. Magnolia Pier and ramp discussion
   d. St Peters timeline, use of boardwalk
   e. Any other HM items

4. Finance report

   a. Next budget cycle
   b. Fees that were discussed for change in next fiscal year.
   c. Launch revenue

5. Public Facilities report –

   a. Site visits update ( I4C2, St Peter's Public Doc/Landing, 112 Commercial Street)
   b. Strategic focus for public Facilities.
   c. I4C2 Planks Project Update

6. Discussion of strategic direction. Off season priorities

   a. Financial
   b. Staffing
   c. Board makeup
   d. Where to focus limited resources

7. Discussion items that were not reasonably anticipated by the Chairperson, In accordance with M.G.L, CH. 30A, Sec. 18-25

8. Adjourn
